headline: Pakistan Textile Exports Increase 6.35% to $6.8 Billion in July-October
summary: Textile and clothing exports from Pakistan grew 6.35% to $6.8 billion during the July-October period. Modest growth was limited by elevated domestic input costs and international shipment delays according to government statistics.
why: Textiles represent Pakistan's largest manufacturing and export sector. Export volume data directly impacts the country's foreign exchange earnings and trade deficit balancing.
